Your figures match the billing export. It has no churn column, but churn can be derived from the MRR, new and expansion fields. For example, June MRR of $63,000 plus $8,100 of new and expansion MRR, less July MRR of $66,000, leaves about $5,100 lost.

Toast vs. others: the billing export does not split MRR or churn by POS, so I can't give a dollar breakdown. Customer success records that about 40 single-location Toast restaurants cancelled from July to September, mostly citing sync errors, and that Square and Clover customers showed no unusual cancellations. A mid-August count was 14 cancellations in July and 11 in early August, almost all Toast.

Harbor & Vine: the account ($9,200 MRR) gave notice on 2026-09-22, effective 2026-11-21. The export doesn't say whether September's $68,000 MRR reflects it. Since the effective date is in November, it would normally fall after September, but the data room doesn't confirm this. Dana is meeting their CFO on 2026-10-06 to try to save the account.

Orders API v2 rebuild: it has not started. On 2026-07-21 the team chose a hotfix over a rebuild, with a plan to revisit in Q4. On 2026-08-11 Dana said the rebuild would not happen before the Meridian launch. Meridian has since paused (2026-09-24). No start date for the rebuild is recorded.

answers.answer:
The bank export confirms your figures:
- June: cash fell from $3,069,000 to $2,918,000 ($151,000 net burn).
- September: cash fell from $2,561,000 to $2,347,000 ($214,000 net burn).

By line item, June to September:
- Payroll out rose from $154,100 to $208,700.
- Other out rose from $59,900 to $73,300.
- Revenue collected rose only from $63,000 to $68,000.

Over the same period, headcount fell from 17 to 15. The data room does not explain why payroll rose while headcount fell.

Runway planning: the only runway model is dated 2026-05-31 and shows about 22 months at $140k a month. It assumed MRR would keep growing about 10% a month, and it has not been updated. At the 2026-09-15 leadership sync, Dana estimated about 12 months at the current rate, and less once the H2 hires start. The H2 hiring plan said net burn would stay under $160k a month through December. The six H2 roles remain open, and whether to cut them has not been decided; it will be revisited after the bridge conversations. No updated runway figure is documented.

Bridge: this is exploratory. The record says Dana will sound out Northbeam and Ridgeline informally in October about a $750k to $1M SAFE. No target close date is documented.

Deal ownership: sales headcount is now 1, and the search for a Head of Sales replacement has not started. The data room does not say who now owns the 3 active deals.

Meridian: Meridian paused the pilot on 2026-09-24 "until SOC 2 Type II is in place", with Q3 2027 as the earliest realistic date. Nothing in the data room confirms whether the LOI remains in force during the pause.
